name: Conexeu Sciences Inc.
summary: Conexeu Sciences Inc. specializes in pioneering regenerative biomaterials intended for various medical fields, including wound management, dental practices, and aesthetic medicine. The enterprise began operations on November 2, 2022, co-founded by Claudia Chavez-Munoz, David R. Bogart, and Ryan Hartwell, and operates from its primary office in Reno, Nevada.
